dialogues.jp: 暇だ。
dialogues.en: So bored.
dialogues.text: So bored.

dialogues.jp: ゴールデンウィーク初日。
dialogues.en: It was the first day of Golden Week.
dialogues.text: It was the first day of Golden Week.

dialogues.jp:
と、いっても学校は暦通りのため、普通の日曜
とあまり変わらないのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Although since it was a Sunday, there was no noticable
difference.
dialogues.text:
Although since it was a Sunday, there was no noticable
difference.

dialogues.jp: 俺はとっても暇だった。
dialogues.en: I had nothing to do whatsoever.
dialogues.text: I had nothing to do whatsoever.

dialogues.jp: 環は今日も巫女部に参加している。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was busy at the Miko Club today.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was busy at the Miko Club today.

dialogues.jp: はあ〜。
dialogues.en: Haah~.
dialogues.text: Haah~.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、淋しいかな……。
dialogues.en: I feel kinda lonely...
dialogues.text: I feel kinda lonely...

dialogues.jp: デートをする機会もなかなかない。
dialogues.en: There hadn't been any chance to go on a date.
dialogues.text: There hadn't been any chance to go on a date.

dialogues.jp: ま、ちょっと我慢すれば、巫女部の合宿だ。
dialogues.en:
Well, I'd just tolerate this a while longer, and go to the
Miko Club training camp.
dialogues.text:
Well, I'd just tolerate this a while longer, and go to the
Miko Club training camp.

dialogues.jp: そうしたら、一緒にいられる時間もあるだろう。
dialogues.en: We should be able to spend time together there.
dialogues.text: We should be able to spend time together there.

dialogues.jp: 夜も一緒にいるわけだし。
dialogues.en: Especially at night.
dialogues.text: Especially at night.

dialogues.jp: ……もちろん、二人きりではないが……。
dialogues.en: ...Of course, not completely alone...
dialogues.text: ...Of course, not completely alone...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃ〜ん♪」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chan~"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chan~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Oh?"
dialogues.text: "Oh?"

dialogues.jp:
窓から、うたまるを頭にのせたさくらが入って
くる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura came crawling in from the window, with Utamaru
sitting proudly on her head.
dialogues.text:
Sakura came crawling in from the window, with Utamaru
sitting proudly on her head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ほにゃ？　元気っかな〜？」
dialogues.en: "Honya? How're you doing~?"
dialogues.text: "Honya? How're you doing~?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「相変わらず、不法侵入が好きなやつだな」
dialogues.en: "You're as fond of tresspassing as ever, huh."
dialogues.text: "You're as fond of tresspassing as ever, huh."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「玄関から入ってくればいいだろうが」
dialogues.en: "The entranceway is meant for entering, ya know."
dialogues.text: "The entranceway is meant for entering, ya know."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だってぇ。追い出されたら嫌だもん」
dialogues.en: "I don't wanna be chased out!"
dialogues.text: "I don't wanna be chased out!"

dialogues.jp: 「勝手に入ってきても、追い出すぞ」
dialogues.en: "You're trespassing private property, get out."
dialogues.text: "You're trespassing private property, get out."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「え〜！　そない殺生なこと言わんといてくだ
　さいよ」
dialogues.en: "Ehh~! Don't be hatin' on me!"
dialogues.text: "Ehh~! Don't be hatin' on me!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……おまえ、生まれはどこなんだよ。インチ
　キ方言使いやがって」
dialogues.en:
"...Where've you been brought up, to learn that kind of
dialect?"
dialogues.text:
"...Where've you been brought up, to learn that kind of
dialect?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「へへ、兄さん。だいぶ荒れてらっしゃります
　ね」
dialogues.en: "Heheh, my bro's being hella angry, huh?"
dialogues.text: "Heheh, my bro's being hella angry, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なんなら、あっしが慰めてさしあげやしょう
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"Hows bout we go ridin' dirty outside to forget ya troubles,
dawg?"
dialogues.text:
"Hows bout we go ridin' dirty outside to forget ya troubles,
dawg?"

dialogues.jp: さくらの変な口調は直る気配がない。
dialogues.en: Her inane chatter was best left ignored.
dialogues.text: Her inane chatter was best left ignored.

dialogues.jp: まあ、退屈しのぎにはちょうどいいかも。
dialogues.en: At least it can't get boring now.
dialogues.text: At least it can't get boring now.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「さては、はは〜ん。デートの約束を断られや
　したね」
dialogues.en: "Now then! You look like you've just had a date rejected."
dialogues.text: "Now then! You look like you've just had a date rejected."

dialogues.jp: まさか、図星とは言えない。
dialogues.en: I can't let her know she's right on the mark.
dialogues.text: I can't let her know she's right on the mark.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよね。環ちゃん、忙しそうだもんね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. Tamaki-chan sure looked busy lately."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. Tamaki-chan sure looked busy lately."

dialogues.jp: さくらは笑いながらやっといつもの口調に戻る。
dialogues.en: Sakura giggled a little, returning back to her usual voice.
dialogues.text: Sakura giggled a little, returning back to her usual voice.

dialogues.jp: 「お前は、暇そうだよな」
dialogues.en: "You must be really bored."
dialogues.text: "You must be really bored."

dialogues.jp: 嫌味の一つも言いたくなる。
dialogues.en: The irritation was free-flowing.
dialogues.text: The irritation was free-flowing.

dialogues.jp: 「お前、学校にも行かずに一体何やってんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What were you doing at school, anyway?"
dialogues.text: "What were you doing at school, anyway?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「へっへっへっ。秘密秘密」
dialogues.en: "Hehehe, that's a secret, secret!"
dialogues.text: "Hehehe, that's a secret, secret!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「秘密……ね」
dialogues.en: "A secret... huh."
dialogues.text: "A secret... huh."

dialogues.jp: どうせロクなことしてないんだろう。
dialogues.en: Can't be anything important, I bet.
dialogues.text: Can't be anything important, I bet.

dialogues.jp: 「あ〜あ。お前は気楽でいいよな」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh~. It must be nice to be so carefree like you."
dialogues.text: "Ahhh~. It must be nice to be so carefree like you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　ボクにだって一応悩みはあるよ」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? I'm always worried about something or other."
dialogues.text: "Ehh? I'm always worried about something or other."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「悩み？」
dialogues.en: "You, worried?"
dialogues.text: "You, worried?"

dialogues.jp: そんなもの、さくらにあるのか？
dialogues.en: Sakura's been that way before?
dialogues.text: Sakura's been that way before?

dialogues.jp: どう見たって能天気極まりないが……。
dialogues.en: She always seems so cheerful...
dialogues.text: She always seems so cheerful...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん。今日はうたまるのキャットフード、ど
　うしようかな、とか、明日はお天気かな、と
　か」
dialogues.en:
"Yup! Like what kind of cat food to buy today, or how
tomorrow's weather will be!"
dialogues.text:
"Yup! Like what kind of cat food to buy today, or how
tomorrow's weather will be!"

dialogues.jp: 聞いた俺がバカだった。
dialogues.en: Maybe I'm the idiot after all.
dialogues.text: Maybe I'm the idiot after all.

dialogues.jp:
さくらが心の底から悩むことなんて、似合わな
いもんな。
dialogues.en:
It'd be totally unlike her to be worried about something
from the bottom of her heart.
dialogues.text:
It'd be totally unlike her to be worried about something
from the bottom of her heart.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ありゃ。黙っちゃうの？」
dialogues.en: "Ah-ah, why're you so quiet now?"
dialogues.text: "Ah-ah, why're you so quiet now?"

dialogues.jp: ちょっと、答えるの止めておこう。
dialogues.en: I was too irritated to answer.
dialogues.text: I was too irritated to answer.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「元気だしなよ。なんなら、ボクが慰めてあげ
　ようか？」
dialogues.en:
"C'mon, cheer up! Actually... do you want me to console
you?"
dialogues.text:
"C'mon, cheer up! Actually... do you want me to console
you?"

dialogues.jp: 一瞬、さくらの目がキラリと光る。
dialogues.en: In a split second, Sakura's eyes lighted up.
dialogues.text: In a split second, Sakura's eyes lighted up.

dialogues.jp: ついでに、うたまるの目も光る。
dialogues.en: Utamaru's eyes followed as well.
dialogues.text: Utamaru's eyes followed as well.

dialogues.jp: ったく、何考えてんだこいつは。
dialogues.en: What are these two thinking...
dialogues.text: What are these two thinking...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「せーの！」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「う、うわ！」
dialogues.en: "W, waaah!"
dialogues.text: "W, waaah!"

dialogues.jp:
さくらはいきなり俺の腰を掴み、ごにょごにょ、
とくすぐりだした。
dialogues.en: Sakura suddenly grabbed me at my waist and started tickling.
dialogues.text: Sakura suddenly grabbed me at my waist and started tickling.

dialogues.jp: 「う、やめろやめろ！！」
dialogues.en: "Haha... S, stop it!"
dialogues.text: "Haha... S, stop it!"

dialogues.jp:
俺はあまりのくすぐったさに、うっすら目に涙
を浮かべる。
dialogues.en:
I could barely control my laughter. Tears were starting to
flow from my eyes.
dialogues.text:
I could barely control my laughter. Tears were starting to
flow from my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どう？　楽しいでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Now isn't this fun?"
dialogues.text: "Now isn't this fun?"

dialogues.jp: さくらは喜々として、くすぐる手をやめない。
dialogues.en: Sakura happily continued her tickle torture.
dialogues.text: Sakura happily continued her tickle torture.

dialogues.jp: 「ひっ、わ、わかった、本当にごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "O, okay, hehe... I, I'm sorry!"
dialogues.text: "O, okay, hehe... I, I'm sorry!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は必死に抵抗する。
dialogues.en: I tried to resist as much as possible.
dialogues.text: I tried to resist as much as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、止めてあげるから、デートしよ！」
dialogues.en: "If you want me to stop, then go on a date with me!"
dialogues.text: "If you want me to stop, then go on a date with me!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「き、汚ねえぞ！」
dialogues.en: "T, that's blackmail!"
dialogues.text: "T, that's blackmail!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は笑いながら叫ぶ。
dialogues.en: I managed to yell out in between fits of laughter.
dialogues.text: I managed to yell out in between fits of laughter.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　まだこのままがいいの？」
dialogues.en: "Oh really? Shall I keep going then?"
dialogues.text: "Oh really? Shall I keep going then?"

dialogues.jp: さくらは更にくすぐる手を早める。
dialogues.en: She increased the speed of her tickling.
dialogues.text: She increased the speed of her tickling.

dialogues.jp: 「わかった、わかった、付き合うよ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, okay, I will!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, okay, I will!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は見事にさくらの作戦に屈してしまった。
dialogues.en: I finally succumbed to Sakura's mission.
dialogues.text: I finally succumbed to Sakura's mission.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「よし、じゃ、桜公園へレッツゴー！」
dialogues.en: "Right! Let's go to the Sakura Park!"
dialogues.text: "Right! Let's go to the Sakura Park!"

dialogues.jp: さくらはやっと、俺から手を離す。
dialogues.en: Sakura finally released her hands from my hips.
dialogues.text: Sakura finally released her hands from my hips.

dialogues.jp: やれやれ。
dialogues.en: Hoo boy.
dialogues.text: Hoo boy.

dialogues.jp: ま、ちょうどいい暇つぶしになる。
dialogues.en: Well, I was bored anyway.
dialogues.text: Well, I was bored anyway.

dialogues.jp: 俺とさくらは、自宅を出て桜公園へ向かった。
dialogues.en: Sakura and I left my home, and set off for the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text: Sakura and I left my home, and set off for the Sakura Park.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はにゃ〜ん。いいお天気」
dialogues.en: "Hanyan~. Such good weather!"
dialogues.text: "Hanyan~. Such good weather!"

dialogues.jp: さくらは大きく伸びをする。
dialogues.en: Sakura stretched her arms out to greet the sunlgiht.
dialogues.text: Sakura stretched her arms out to greet the sunlgiht.

dialogues.jp: 本当に、いい天気だ。
dialogues.en: It really is good weather, though.
dialogues.text: It really is good weather, though.

dialogues.jp: 時折、爽やかな風が吹く。
dialogues.en: A light, calming breeze blew by every few minutes too.
dialogues.text: A light, calming breeze blew by every few minutes too.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「気持ちいいねえ」
dialogues.en: "Doesn't it feel nice?"
dialogues.text: "Doesn't it feel nice?"

dialogues.jp: さくらは目をつぶり、風を顔で受けている。
dialogues.en:
She inclined her neck towards the direction of the wind,
letting it brush past her face.
dialogues.text:
She inclined her neck towards the direction of the wind,
letting it brush past her face.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「隣にいるのが、環ちゃんだったら、もっと良
　かったんだろうね、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en:
"Of course, if it was Tamaki-chan next to you instead of me,
you'd be happier."
dialogues.text:
"Of course, if it was Tamaki-chan next to you instead of me,
you'd be happier."

dialogues.jp: さくらは笑って俺に言う。
dialogues.en: She giggled as she teased me.
dialogues.text: She giggled as she teased me.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、そうでもないぞ」
dialogues.en: "That's not exactly true."
dialogues.text: "That's not exactly true."

dialogues.jp: 贅沢を言えばそうだが……。
dialogues.en: Although that may be exaggerating a bit as well...
dialogues.text: Although that may be exaggerating a bit as well...

dialogues.jp: でも、こんな天気の良い日だ。
dialogues.en: But this weather really makes it a fine day.
dialogues.text: But this weather really makes it a fine day.

dialogues.jp: 連れ出してくれたさくらに感謝するべきだろう。
dialogues.en: I kind of feel like thanking Sakura for getting me out here.
dialogues.text: I kind of feel like thanking Sakura for getting me out here.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、枯れない桜のところに行かない？」
dialogues.en: "Hey hey, can we go to the Unwithering Sakura place?"
dialogues.text: "Hey hey, can we go to the Unwithering Sakura place?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あそこに……？」
dialogues.en: "There...?"
dialogues.text: "There...?"

dialogues.jp: 俺と、さくらが再会を約束した場所。
dialogues.en: The place where Sakura and I promised to meet again.
dialogues.text: The place where Sakura and I promised to meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「早く早く」
dialogues.en: "Hurry, hurry!"
dialogues.text: "Hurry, hurry!"

dialogues.jp:
さくらは俺の腕を引っ張り、枯れない桜へと連
れて行く。
dialogues.en:
Sakura tugged on my arm, leading me to the location of the
Unwithering Sakura.
dialogues.text:
Sakura tugged on my arm, leading me to the location of the
Unwithering Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 「おっと」
dialogues.en: "Whoa."
dialogues.text: "Whoa."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだか、二人で来るの、久しぶりだね」
dialogues.en: "It's been so long since we both came here."
dialogues.text: "It's been so long since we both came here."

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、枯れない桜の幹を触りながら、ポツ
リとつぶやいた。
dialogues.en:
She stared at the trunk of the Unwithering Sakura tree as
she whispered.
dialogues.text:
She stared at the trunk of the Unwithering Sakura tree as
she whispered.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it has."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it has."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「この木の下で、願い事をすると叶うって、誰
　かが言ってたね」
dialogues.en:
"It's been said that wishes made while under this tree can
come true."
dialogues.text:
"It's been said that wishes made while under this tree can
come true."

dialogues.jp: そういえば、そんな噂を前に聞いたことがある。
dialogues.en: I've heard that rumour before...
dialogues.text: I've heard that rumour before...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だから、お兄ちゃんに会えたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "After all, I met onii-chan again."
dialogues.text: "After all, I met onii-chan again."

dialogues.jp: いつになく。
dialogues.en: It was a rare sight...
dialogues.text: It was a rare sight...

dialogues.jp: しんみりしたさくらが、そこにいた。
dialogues.en: To see Sakura, so solemn and serious.
dialogues.text: To see Sakura, so solemn and serious.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だけど……」
さくらは、突然、桜の木を抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: Sakura suddenly hugged the tree tightly.
dialogues.text: Sakura suddenly hugged the tree tightly.

dialogues.jp: さくらは、小さな声でつぶやく。
dialogues.en: She then whispered in a tiny voice.
dialogues.text: She then whispered in a tiny voice.

dialogues.jp: 聞こえるか、聞こえないかの声で。
dialogues.en: One that was barely audible, yet I could hear part of it.
dialogues.text: One that was barely audible, yet I could hear part of it.

dialogues.jp: 『もう、お別れだね』って……。
dialogues.en: "We'd have to part soon"... she said...
dialogues.text: "We'd have to part soon"... she said...

dialogues.jp: 俺には、そう聞こえた。
dialogues.en: I could catch that much.
dialogues.text: I could catch that much.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、さくら……」
dialogues.en: "Oy, Sakura..."
dialogues.text: "Oy, Sakura..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は確かめようと、さくらに呼びかける。
dialogues.en: Confused, I called out to her.
dialogues.text: Confused, I called out to her.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、さくらはそのまま、答えようとはしな
い。
dialogues.en: But she continued hugging the tree, not replying to me.
dialogues.text: But she continued hugging the tree, not replying to me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さて、帰ろうか？」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go?"

dialogues.jp:
さくらは木から離れ、いつも通りの明るい声で
言った。
dialogues.en:
Sakura finally let go of the tree, and her usual bright and
cheerful voice returned.
dialogues.text:
Sakura finally let go of the tree, and her usual bright and
cheerful voice returned.

dialogues.jp: 空耳だったのか？
dialogues.en: Were my ears playing tricks on me?
dialogues.text: Were my ears playing tricks on me?

dialogues.jp:
さっきのさくらの言葉は気のせいだったのだろ
うか？
dialogues.en: It wasn't just my imagination that she said that, right?
dialogues.text: It wasn't just my imagination that she said that, right?

dialogues.jp: 「もう帰るのか？」
dialogues.en: "You're going back already?"
dialogues.text: "You're going back already?"

dialogues.jp:
思わず、普段なら口にしないことを言ってしま
う。
dialogues.en:
But in the end, the words that came out of my mouth were no
different from usual.
dialogues.text:
But in the end, the words that came out of my mouth were no
different from usual.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あれ？　お兄ちゃん、ひょっとしてボクに情
　が移った？」
dialogues.en: "Hmhm? Onii-chan, did you suddenly grow feelings for me?"
dialogues.text: "Hmhm? Onii-chan, did you suddenly grow feelings for me?"

dialogues.jp: 情ってなんだよ。
dialogues.en: Feelings? What the...
dialogues.text: Feelings? What the...

dialogues.jp: 「んなわけねえだろ」
dialogues.en: "No frickin' way."
dialogues.text: "No frickin' way."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「またまた、照れちゃって。かわいいね♪」
dialogues.en: "You're still so cute when you're embarassed~"
dialogues.text: "You're still so cute when you're embarassed~"

dialogues.jp: さくらは俺の腕に引っ付いてくる。
dialogues.en: She started to lean on my arm again.
dialogues.text: She started to lean on my arm again.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、こら。やめろって」
dialogues.en: "Hey, geez, stop it already."
dialogues.text: "Hey, geez, stop it already."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「まあまあ、環ちゃんには黙っててあげるから
　さ」
dialogues.en:
"Now now, don't you worry, I'd keep it a secret from
Tamaki-chan!"
dialogues.text:
"Now now, don't you worry, I'd keep it a secret from
Tamaki-chan!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もう！　離せー！」
dialogues.en: "Just let me go already!"
dialogues.text: "Just let me go already!"

dialogues.jp:
俺の腕にさくらがぶら下がったまま、自宅まで
帰る羽目となった。
dialogues.en: With Sakura still glued to my arm, I trudged back home.
dialogues.text: With Sakura still glued to my arm, I trudged back home.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらと桜◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura and the Sakura?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura and the Sakura?◆

dialogues.jp: 合宿が始まるまで、環と会えない日々が続く。
dialogues.en:
With the training camp looming, the days without spending
time with Tamaki continued.
dialogues.text:
With the training camp looming, the days without spending
time with Tamaki continued.

dialogues.jp:
自宅で暇をもてあましていると、さくらが家に
侵入してくる。
dialogues.en:
I was at home, bored, when Sakura invaded my personal space
yet again.
dialogues.text:
I was at home, bored, when Sakura invaded my personal space
yet again.

dialogues.jp:
俺をくすぐってデートを強要され、一緒に桜公
園へ行くことになった。
dialogues.en:
She coerced a date out of me through tickle-torture, and we
went to the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text:
She coerced a date out of me through tickle-torture, and we
went to the Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp: 枯れない桜のもとへ行き、しんみりするさくら。
dialogues.en:
We went to the Unwithering Sakura tree, where Sakura
suddenly got solemn.
dialogues.text:
We went to the Unwithering Sakura tree, where Sakura
suddenly got solemn.

dialogues.jp:
なぜか、さくらが桜の木に向かって『もうお別
れだね』と、言ったように聞こえた。
dialogues.en:
I'm sure I heard her whisper to the tree that "We have to
part soon"....
dialogues.text:
I'm sure I heard her whisper to the tree that "We have to
part soon"....
